stringUnit.value: Read current records and review actions. Availability depends on scoped approval and current permissions.
读取当前记录并预览操作。是否可提交取决于限定授权和当前权限。
选择服务端提供的岗位
The record or permissions changed. Reload and review again.
记录或权限已变化，请刷新后重新预览。
Prepare deletion of the existing public merchant reply.
准备删除现有公开商家回复。
Your current business identity does not have access.
当前经营身份没有此权限。
Live dispatch is disabled. This review does not change any business record.
真实提交暂未启用。本次预览不会更改业务记录。
Only the source evidence object-key format is accepted. Native image upload is not enabled.
仅接受源协议规定的凭证对象键格式。原生图片上传尚未启用。
本月个人渠道到账毛额
本月个人渠道到账净额
Check the fields and try again.
请检查填写内容后重试。
Recovery data could not be verified. Dispatch is blocked.
无法核验恢复记录，已阻止提交。
Could not load these records. Try again.
暂时无法加载记录，请重试。
This form is local until a frozen review is explicitly confirmed.
表单先保存在本页，预览确认前不会提交。
The response is incomplete or belongs to another record.
回执不完整，或与当前记录不一致。
A merchant opinion does not execute a refund. The platform determines the outcome.
商家意见不会执行退款。最终结果由平台确认。
The platform response confirms a refund.
Before synthetic dispatch, access, store identity, target and version are fetched and checked again.
模拟提交前会重新读取并核对权限、门店身份、目标和版本。
Role changes stay disabled in production. The server's current role list is authoritative.
生产岗位变更保持关闭，以服务端当前岗位列表为准。
Preview a code's source route without opening a camera or redeeming it.
仅预览码的源路由，不打开摄像头，也不执行核销。
输入核销码以本地预览
支持选章或选站的旧版票码
The server has not supplied an authorized spending amount.
服务端未提供可查看的消费金额。
The account or session changed. Reload before continuing.
账号或会话已变化，请重新加载后继续。
Offline example. All people, records and outcomes are synthetic.
离线示例。人物、记录与结果均为虚构测试数据。
A previous request has an unknown result. Sending again is locked, including after reopening. A list refresh cannot prove its outcome.
之前请求的结果尚不确定。再次提交已锁定，重新打开也不会解除。刷新列表不能证明该请求的结果。
This dynamic code type is not supported.
暂不支持此动态码类型。
Classification is not verification. Authenticity and eligibility require the server.
识别码型不等于验证。真实性与可核销资格须由服务端确认。
